records.name: Deadly Dance
records.character_source: Android 18 / Krillin customizable partner / Android 17 (DB Super) customizable partner / Kefla (Super Saiyan) customizable partner
records.skill_description: A series of dance-like kicks that can repel Ki Blasts and ends with a launching somersault kick.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference describes a multi-kick Strike attack with Ki Blast-repelling behavior and a launching final kick. The opponent remains airborne afterward, allowing follow-up attacks.
records.acquisition_notes: Android 18's Lesson 2 training is the canonical Future Warrior acquisition route. Later partner customization can make the skill available to additional customizable partners.
records.pve_notes: Mentor-training acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: The documented move properties include Ki Blast deflection and a launching final hit; detailed frame and matchup behavior is version-sensitive and is not encoded as unsupported numeric data.
